assertions.statement: Modern overview presents the approved three-zone financial panel without redundant month or centralized help blocks.
Confirmed date ranges update all financial fields together; cancelling drafts preserves the applied state and current account stages.
Six field-local help controls support hover, focus, touch and dismissal without clipping.
Classic output is preserved and modern themes, locales and viewport sizes remain readable.
Summary interactions perform no new remote operations and clean up stale context-specific UI.
Keyboard date selection, focus restoration and tooltip descriptions remain valid after rendering.
Synthetic boundary cases retain propSum accounting semantics and cent precision without mutating inputs.
Sparse date-ordered cumulative points start at zero and end at net return, with honest empty or invalid-date states.
Domain and UI responsibilities remain separate, localized and scoped to modern Prop; bundle and syntax checks pass.
